methodSections.heading: Ginger Syrup
steps: Measure equal parts boiling water, sugar and fresh ginger into a blender and blend to a smooth purée.
Strain with a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth, allow to cool and store in the fridge.

methodSections.heading: Penicillin
steps: Measure all ingredients into a cocktail shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously.
Strain into a rocks glass with fresh ice.
Garnish with a lemon twist and slice of ginger.
